sessions.details: Casa Tumbao is a Cuban Salsa Community based in West London (W10 5XL). We host classes for all abilities, from first-timers to seasoned dancers, followed by a free social open to all, 9PM-11:30PM. We will teach you all the steps and the technicalities, but we are not a dance “school”, we are a Community. Our space is for trying something new, getting it wrong, experimenting, playing around, expressing yourself and connecting with yourself, others & the culture. Come for the dancefloor, come for the board games, come for the patties & drinks or come play around on our latin percussion instruments. There’s something for everyone as we curate this space to be our warm Neighbourhood Spot every Tuesday. Book your class via Luma (link in our instagram bio, or copy & paste the link below), send us a DM or pay £10 on the door. https://luma.com/user/casatumbao We also recognise that we are guests to Cuban culture. A culture that has so kindly welcomed us in. sessions.title: AfroCuban and Rumba in Social Dance Bootcamp with Osbanis & Anneta
sessions.details: Discover how to bring flavour, rhythm, body movement and expression into your social dancing. 💫 AFRO-CUBAN & RUMBA IN SOCIAL DANCE. 💫 2.5-HOUR SPECIAL BOOTCAMP · 14:30–17:00 From roots to expression. From folkloric movement to social dance. Explore the richness of Afro-Cuban movement and rumba, understand their connection to Cuban music, and discover how to incorporate their distinctive flavour into your social dancing. Discover the roots. Feel the rhythm. Bring the flavour to your dancing! Afro-Cuban movement and Cuban Rumba are at the heart of Cuban dance culture. They bring a unique richness of movement, rhythm, expression and musicality that can transform the way you dance. In this special bootcamp, we’ll explore the connection between Afro-Cuban movement, Rumba and social dance, helping you understand not only where these movements come from, but also how to incorporate their flavour into your dancing. WHAT WILL WE EXPLORE? 🔥 Afro-Cuban movement – body articulation, coordination, grounding and expression. 🪘 Rumba & its rhythms – discover characteristic movement vocabulary and elements of Cuban Rumba. 🎵 Musicality & interpretation – understand how to respond to the rhythms, accents and energy of Cuban music. 💃 From roots to social dance – learn how to bring Afro-Cuban and Rumba influences into your Cuban salsa dancing. ✨ Flavour & expression – develop a more expressive, dynamic and authentic way of moving. Come and explore the roots of Cuban dance and discover how to bring them to life on the social dance floor! 📅 TIME: 28th November 2026, 14:30–17:00 (2.5 hours) 📍 LOCATION: The O2 Centre Finchley Road, Finchley Road tube station, NW3 6LU HOW TO SIGN UP? 1. sessions.details: Discover how to bring flavour, rhythm, body movement and expression into your social dancing. 💫 AFRO-CUBAN & RUMBA IN SOCIAL DANCE 💫 2.5-HOUR SPECIAL BOOTCAMP · 14:30–17:00 with @osbanis_deakocan & @anneta_deakocan From roots to expression. Explore the richness of Afro-Cuban movement and rumba, understand their connection to Cuban music, and discover how to incorporate their distinctive flavour into your social dancing. Discover the roots. Feel the rhythm. Bring the flavour to your dancing! Afro-Cuban movement and Cuban Rumba are at the heart of Cuban dance culture. They bring a unique richness of movement, rhythm, expression and musicality that can transform the way you dance. In this special bootcamp, we’ll explore the connection between Afro-Cuban movement, Rumba and social dance, helping you understand not only where these movements come from, but also how to incorporate their flavour into your dancing. Come and explore the roots of Cuban dance and discover how to bring them to life on the social dance floor! 📅 TIME: 28th November 2026, 14:30–17:00 (2.5 hours) 📍 LOCATION: The O2 Centre Finchley Road, Finchley Road tube station, NW3 6LU HOW TO SIGN UP? 1. Fill in a registration form https://forms.gle/cmRdNz3XtaM7yAiU8 2. Make the payment 3. See you in the studio 🤩 Link in the bio 🗓️✍️ Don’t miss out – Book Now! 🥳 The spaces are limited, we advise to book in advance to guarantee the availability. #AfroCuban #CubanRumba #CubanDance #cubansalsalondon #LondonDance

sessions.title: Casa Tumbao: Classes, Social & Community
sessions.details: Casa Tumbao is a Cuban Salsa Community based in West London (W10 5XL). We host classes for all abilities, from first-timers to seasoned dancers, followed by a free social open to all, 9PM-11:30PM. We will teach you all the steps and the technicalities, but we are not a dance “school”, we are a Community. Our space is for trying something new, getting it wrong, experimenting, playing around, expressing yourself and connecting with yourself, others & the culture. Come for the dancefloor, come for the board games, come for the patties & drinks or come play around on our latin percussion instruments. There’s something for everyone as we curate this space to be our warm Neighbourhood Spot every Tuesday. Book your class via Luma (link in our instagram bio, or copy & paste the link below), send us a DM or pay £10 on the door. https://luma.com/user/casatumbao We also recognise that we are guests to Cuban culture. A culture that has so kindly welcomed us in. That’s why 10% of all our profits go to the AfroCuban Dance Festival’s Community Project, which supports the dancers, teachers and artists who keep this culture alive in Pogolotti, Havana. Tuesdays @ Casa Tumbao Running Order: 6:30-7:30 || 2 Classes Intro to Cuban Salsa Cuban Salsa Fundamentals 7:45-8:45 || 2 Classes Intermediate Class Advanced Class (5 Week Rotating Teacher Resiencies) 8:45-11:30 || Salsa Social (free & open to all) See you on the dancefloor!

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: El Grande
sessions.details: For Your Diaries…..Something to look forward to…London and the UK Get Ready! ‘EL GRANDE’ CHRISTMAS PARTY @ SCALA FRIDAY 18TH DECEMBER! NO DANCE CLASSES, PARTY ALL NIGHT! 🔥🔥 Time: 10 30 pm to 5 am 🎼💃🍹🕺 The People’s favourite Latin dance party in London returns to Scala in King’s Cross, to celebrate Christmas! Once again, ‘EL GRANDE’ brings its unique 4 dance rooms format trademark, of Latin and Afro-Latin music and dance fun and happiness to the masses in London, the UK and further afield. Thus, prepare yourselves for another full on, unforgettable night of Latin dance fireworks in 4 different dance arenas, lasting into the early hours of the morning. sessions.title: Rueda Pro Course
sessions.details: Rueda Pro – Advanced Course Already danced 15+ Rueda Plus classes or passed the Crown assessment? Welcome to Rueda Pro. This course builds on all previous rueda levels and introduces new concepts, faster structures, and original combinations, all while highlighting individual responsibility and musical connection. We will also work on calling a rueda and the challenges with doing so. This is a 7 week course. 2 of the 7 weeks will be recap weeks, so if you may mis one or two classes it is not the end of the world. But ideally try to make them all. Please note no class will occur 10/2/27. Entry requirement: 15+ Rueda Plus classes or assessment Designed for confident dancers ready to push further Faster pace, new moves, deeper concepts Why choose Rueda Libre courses? • Small group sizes • Focused feedback from expert teachers • Real progress • Strong community vibe • Ideal prep for socials & festivals Spots are limited. Questions? DM us or email contact@ruedalibre.co.uk

sessions.title: Casino Fundamentals – Cuban salsa course fundamentals
sessions.details: Ready to Start up or improve your salsa? Rueda Libre is excited to announce a focused course starting Wednesday 6th January, designed to help you build strong foundations and sharpen your Cuban salsa dancing skills. This course is designed for absolute beginners or anyone looking to build a strong foundation including those learning how to lead. Expect personal feedback, a supportive vibe, and real progress over four weeks. Cuban Salsa for Beginners + Improvers 🗓 Wednesdays: 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th 7-9pm (8 hours total) 💰 £89 per person 👫 No partner needed 👟 No experience required This is the perfect course if you’re new to Cuban salsa or want to refresh your fundamentals. It’s also ideal for those looking to learn how to lead for the first time. We’ll guide you step-by-step through the feeling, moves, and energy of Cuban dance in a welcoming and supportive space. 🎯 Why join? • Small class sizes for personalised attention • Opportunities to ask questions and receive individual feedback • Designed by experienced teachers who understand your journey • Supportive, inclusive environment Spaces are limited, book early to secure your place! Leads are the ones who direct and guide the dance. Follows are the ones interpreting the leads gestures and moving accordingly. Leads are typically male roles where follows are typically female

We host classes for all abilities, from first-timers to seasoned dancers, followed by a free social open to all, 9PM-11:30PM. We will teach you all the steps and the technicalities, but we are not a dance “school”, we are a Community. Our space is for trying something new, getting it wrong, experimenting, playing around, expressing yourself and connecting with yourself, others & the culture. Come for the dancefloor, come for the board games, come for the patties & drinks or come play around on our latin percussion instruments. There’s something for everyone as we curate this space to be our warm Neighbourhood Spot every Tuesday. Book your class via Luma (link in our instagram bio, or copy & paste the link below), send us a DM or pay £10 on the door. https://luma.com/user/casatumbao We also recognise that we are guests to Cuban culture. A culture that has so kindly welcomed us in. That’s why 10% of all our profits go to the AfroCuban Dance Festival’s Community Project, which supports the dancers, teachers and artists who keep this culture alive in Pogolotti, Havana. We host classes for all abilities, from first-timers to seasoned dancers, followed by a free social open to all, 9PM-11:30PM. We will teach you all the steps and the technicalities, but we are not a dance “school”, we are a Community. Our space is for trying something new, getting it wrong, experimenting, playing around, expressing yourself and connecting with yourself, others & the culture. Come for the dancefloor, come for the board games, come for the patties & drinks or come play around on our latin percussion instruments. There’s something for everyone as we curate this space to be our warm Neighbourhood Spot every Tuesday. Book your class via Luma (link in our instagram bio, or copy & paste the link below), send us a DM or pay £10 on the door. https://luma.com/user/casatumbao We also recognise that we are guests to Cuban culture. A culture that has so kindly welcomed us in. That’s why 10% of all our profits go to the AfroCuban Dance Festival’s Community Project, which supports the dancers, teachers and artists who keep this culture alive in Pogolotti, Havana. Tuesdays @ Casa Tumbao Running Order: 6:30-7:30 || 2 Classes Intro to Cuban Salsa Cuban Salsa Fundamentals 7:45-8:45 || 2 Classes Intermediate Class Advanced Class (5 Week Rotating Teacher Resiencies) 8:45-11:30 || Salsa Social (free & open to all) See you on the dancefloor!

sessions.title: Latin Kiss Tuesdays Classes & Social
sessions.details: 💃Ready to spice up your Tuesdays? 🌶️🔥 🎉 Join us at LatinKiss for an unforgettable salsa experience! Whether you’re a beginner or already have some moves, our classes are packed with energy, passion, and fun. 💃🕺 💥 What to expect: 💥 ✅ Fun and energetic atmosphere ✅ Easy-to-follow instructions ✅ Exciting routines and footwork ✅ Partner work and social dancing ✅ Boosted confidence and fitness while having the time of your life—without even noticing! 🗓️ Mark your calendars: 📅 Date: TUESDAYS 🚪 Doors open: 7:30pm ⏰ Classes: 8pm – 9pm 💃 Social: 9pm – 11pm 📍 Location: The Winchmore – N21 1QA ✨ Don’t miss out—grab your dancing shoes and join the hottest salsa scene in town! ✨

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.address: O2 Centre,The Venue Hall, 255 Finchley Road, London
sessions.title: Cubaneando saturday workshop
sessions.details: ★SATURDAYS INFO: If you booked for Saturday you have already paid online Remember there are 10h & 12h Bundles available for £60 depending on your level. We’re hosting an exciting night of intensive salsa courses and free social dancing at the O2 Shopping Centre on Finchley Road. Join us from 5 PM to 8 PM for classes, and then keep the energy going with free dancing from 8 PM to 11:30 PM. It’s a great opportunity to hone your skills and connect with our lively salsa community! Everyone is welcome, whether you join the lessons or just want to dance. We’ll be grooving on Level 2 near the seating area, so come on down! Plus, don’t forget to check out the nearby restaurants and supermarkets to complete your night—there’s even 2 hours of free parking when you shop at Sainsbury’s!

sessions.details: Experience the rhythm of Cuba every week with Cuban Sundays by Sambroso Sambroso! A vibrant mix of live music, DJs, dance, and cocktails. sessions.title: Salsa Secrets Classes & Social
sessions.details: 🌟 SUNDAYS ARE FOR SALSA SECRETS 🌟 💃 The longest-running salsa school in North London – over 30 years of rhythm, passion & community! This isn’t just a class. It’s an experience. The music, the people, the energy — Sunday nights belong to Salsa Secrets. 📍 652 Hertford Road, Enfield, EN3 6LZ 🕗 Classes start 8PM sharp – arrive early, feel the buzz 🎉 Social dancing until late – dance, connect, celebrate 💨 Fully air-conditioned – cool comfort, hot moves 🍹 Bar open all night – drinks, laughter & good times 🎵 The best Cuban beats – non-stop energy on the floor ✨ Your teaching team: Elliot Johnson Mia Suarez Carlton Thomas 🔥 Why Salsa Secrets? Legendary vibes & welcoming community The ultimate Sunday night workout (without it feeling like one) A salsa family like no other 👯‍♂️ Bring a partner — or come alone! Unmissable. 👉 Tag your dance partner (or future one!) 👉 Bring your friends 👉 Or just bring yourself — you’ll be part of the family from the first step #salsa #cuba #sunday #northlondon #dance

sessions.title: Casa Tumbao: Classes, Social & Community
sessions.details: Casa Tumbao is a Cuban Salsa Community based in West London (W10 5XL). We host classes for all abilities, from first-timers to seasoned dancers, followed by a free social open to all, 9PM-11:30PM. We will teach you all the steps and the technicalities, but we are not a dance “school”, we are a Community. Our space is for trying something new, getting it wrong, experimenting, playing around, expressing yourself and connecting with yourself, others & the culture. Come for the dancefloor, come for the board games, come for the patties & drinks or come play around on our latin percussion instruments. There’s something for everyone as we curate this space to be our warm Neighbourhood Spot every Tuesday. Book your class via Luma (link in our instagram bio, or copy & paste the link below), send us a DM or pay £10 on the door. https://luma.com/user/casatumbao We also recognise that we are guests to Cuban culture. A culture that has so kindly welcomed us in. That’s why 10% of all our profits go to the AfroCuban Dance Festival’s Community Project, which supports the dancers, teachers and artists who keep this culture alive in Pogolotti, Havana. Tuesdays @ Casa Tumbao Running Order: 6:30-7:30 || 2 Classes Intro to Cuban Salsa Cuban Salsa Fundamentals 7:45-8:45 || 2 Classes Intermediate Class Advanced Class (5 Week Rotating Teacher Resiencies) 8:45-11:30 || Salsa Social (free & open to all) See you on the dancefloor!

sessions.title: Rueda Night
sessions.details: Come and join a fun and friendly worldwide community of Rueda de Casino dancers 🛞🕺💃🏻 Bournemouth has a dedicated Rueda de Casino night 🥳 To begin with there are 2 levels of classes: ** 7:30pm Rueda Flow 💨 ** For those of us obsessed with how far we can push the rueda game. This is a closed group for regular rueda de casino dancers, please message to express interest and to receive an invite. (Arrival from 7:15pm) ** 8:30pm Rueda FUNdamentals 🤩 ** This is suitable for ALL levels of rueda dancers to practise their skills (but you must dance salsa)! We will cover the core moves needed to join social ruedas, with a focus on fun, including calls not used in the Flow class. We will also introduce a partnerwork move each week to improve your social dancing repertoire! (Arrival from 8:15pm ** 9:15pm Salsa only social ** No partner or booking needed (but an invite is needed for the Flow group, and the timing of Flow can change when beginner’s courses are running). 💷 £8 for one class, £12 for both.

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Julia Testas
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Julia's improvisation sessions are inspired by a combination of her own somatic research, 'dissolving', and David Zambrano's concept of 'passing through', a philosophy that suggests that movement neeeds no leader in creation. Connecting, sharing and collaborating, Julia invites you to tap into your body's intelligence and cultivate greater confidence and freedom in your movement. The session encourages playful experimentation as you engage with others in a supportive environment.

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Ayebainemi Ése
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Ayebainemi is a dance artist, movement facilitator and founder of 'bodybased', a space centring Black people's relationships with their bodies through rest, movement and collective care. Opening Practice is an invitation to slow down through gentle movement, touch and stillness. Using repetition and improvisation, we'll explore our unique ways of moving, awakening warmth in the body and reconnecting with ourselves beyond the pace of the city.

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Sophie Arstall
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Sophie is a contemporary dance artist and mother with over 20 years experience dancing, facilitating, teaching, and making work. Influences include Contemporary Release Techniques, Body Mind Centering, Fundamental Movement Patterns, Tai Chi and Qi Gong, Body Weather amongst others. Her class will include guided explorations and simple scores, moving us from an internal focus to the spatial, relational and compositional that is happening all around us.

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Galit Criden
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Galit is the co-founder of Wednesday Moving, a choreographer, and the founder of RESET practice. She will share what she's been cooking up in her new research , Love in Runis, opening up some of the questions she's been exploring around love, conflict and perspective. She'll then guide us through her RESET practice, inviting us into movement, connection and a shared celebration.

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Alexandra Baybutt
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Ali works across movement and performance education, research and creative collaborative projects. This sesion draws from some tools and concepts of the Bartenieff Movement System for movement analysis and somatic experience. Together we will make and exchange movement materials and impulses. Come and play with the space around, between and in us, using Laban's concept of the Kinesphere as a map: Diagonals Forever!

sessions.title: Wednesday Moving - Marianna Sfyridi
sessions.details: Round Chapel Old School Rooms, Powerscroft Road, Hackney E5 0PU • Marianna is a dancer, performer, movement specialist and pharmacist. The development of her 'Circadian Bodies' embodiment practice is rooted in her interdisciplinery background and her research into cultural narratives. sessions.title: Ballet - Introduction to Ballet 6wk Course £95
sessions.details: Instructor: Christina Mittelmaier | Level: Beg | Room: Studio 12 | Location: In Studio Classes | The Introduction to Ballet Course is for you, if you are interested in ballet, but have had no or very few ballet classes in the past. It is suitable for adults of any age and level of fitness and is a sound and careful introduction into ballet technique.During this course you will learn the importance of correct body alignment, core and back strength, the correct use of turn out, the positions of the feet and arms and the importance of musicality through movement. All of which lead to good ballet technique and artistic expression.Each class will consist of barre and centre work. The barre exercises, while warming up the body, will help you improve posture and develop strength and mobility. The centre work will build on the exercises done at the barre and it will take you from simple steps into carefully choreographed basic combinations. Throughout this course you will have the opportunity to ask questions and work towards reaching your personal best through constructive and positive feedback. The class provides a friendly environment in which you can learn and improve and leave each session with the sense of achievement. What to bring: Your lovely selves :) Ballet gear: It can be a leotard and tights, leggings and a t-shirt or track bottoms (not too baggy) and a t-shirt. Anything that will allow you to move freely without being too baggy. Ballet shoes (if you don't have any you can wear socks) A notepad in case you would like to take some notes If you are not certain whether this course is for you please do not hesitate to send me an email at cmm@xristina.com and I will advise you accordingly. This is an adult course but confident 14+ years can join. Looking forward to teaching you and working with you! sessions.title: Ballet - Improvers Ballet Course 6wk £95 Christina Mittelmaier
sessions.details: Instructor: Christina Mittelmaier | Level: Beg/Elem | Room: Studio 12 | Location: In Studio Classes | This Improvers Ballet Course is for you if you have completed at least one of the Pineapple Six Week Introduction to Ballet Courses or you have previous ballet training. During this Course, while you will continue working on the basics, you will also be learning new steps put together in beautifully choreographed combinations. Each class will consist of barre and centre work. The centre work will build on the exercises done at the barre and will take you from simple combinations into more challenging ones, including steps and combinations from the corner. Building correct ballet technique and developing artistic expression will be at the centre of this Pineapple ballet course. Throughout the course, you will have the opportunity to ask questions and work towards reaching your personal best through constructive and positive feedback.

sessions.title: World - Introduction to 'Strictly' Ballroom & Latin 6wk Course £95
sessions.details: Instructor: Alice Gregory | Level: Beg | Room: Studio 11 | Location: In Studio Classes | Intro to Ballroom with Alice Gregory is a beginner friendly introduction to the Ballroom dances seen on Strictly.Float around the dancefloor learning the Foxtrot or if a bit of drama is more for you we'll be practicing the fiery Tango. Throughout the course Alice will help you understand how to lead and follow a partner.This course is perfect for people taking their first steps on the dance floor or those hoping to build confidence by going back to the absolute basics. You don't need to bring a partner, we will partner up in the class and Alice is on hand to dance with everyone. You will leave the course knowledgeable and confident in the basics of Ballroom, ready to explore Pineapple's open ballroom classes and the exciting array of Ballroom dancing events across London. sessions.title: Improvers 2
sessions.details: This class is for adults who have successfully mastered all the elements in Improvers 1 and are competent with double pirouettes and ready to learn fouettés, more complex batterie such as brisé and entrechat trois and more challenging grand allegro such as grand jeté en tournant, grand fouetté sauté and saut de basque. Those attending pointework afterwards must already be sufficiently skilled and strong enough for relevés on one leg in the centre. This course is also suitable for ballet-fit returning dancers who received vocational training to a high level. sessions.title: Absolute Beginner Ballet
sessions.details: Mondays 6:30-7:30pm w/ Iole | This class is geared towards those who have either never taken ballet or are returning from a long hiatus. You will be (re)introduced to classical terminology and movement through a classical ballet barre giving you the opportunity to build core strength, mental and physical flexibility, musicality, and leg tone. Class will conclude with centre practice, which will offer you more freedom of movement and personal creativity. All in a warm, supportive, and welcoming environment.

sessions.title: Ballet Improver
sessions.details: Mondays 7:30-9:00pm w/ Iole | Ballet Improvers offers an open and relaxed atmosphere where dancers are encouraged to take part in discussion and reflection while deepening the foundations of ballet technique. Classes progress gradually, introducing new challenges and technical layers based on the group’s rhythm and development. Iole brings a personal touch to the ballet experience, focusing on expressiveness, musicality, coordination, and the connection between body and space. Great care is given to each dancer’s individual abilities and unique way of expressing the technique.

sessions.title: Adv/Pro Contemporary
sessions.details: Tuesdays 10:00-11:30am w/ Nadine | For professional and advanced level dancers, this contemporary class will have a released based focus with elements of Cunningham technique and inspiration taken from the commercial dance world.Class will follow a similar structure each week, starting with a Gyrokinesis inspired warm up, before moving through a variety of technical exercises to address the whole body before ending with a phrase. Aiming to prepare the body and mind for the day ahead.

sessions.title: Intro to Broadway Jazz
sessions.details: Tuesdays 7:30-8:30pm w/ Mette | A fun, high-energy musical theatre jazz class designed for complete beginners. Explore rhythm, musicality and self-expression in a supportive, feel-good environment. No experience needed! Everything is learned in the room. ​ 07/07-28/07 Bring a friend and experience the joy of dance together | two for the price of one BOOK HERE

sessions.title: 'Bodies in Action' - Ballet for Contemporary Dancers
sessions.details: Wednesdays and Fridays 10:00-11:30am | This class is focused on creating an inclusive and positive space for professional contemporary dancers. We aim to provide a class that will allow the body to become more aware of its physical activity and how we can further develop and hone in on our skills as contemporary dancers.

sessions.title: Contemporary Improver
sessions.details: Wednesdays 6:30-7:30pm w/ Iole | This class invites you to move, connect, and awaken rhythm through contemporary dance blending technique and exploration. Rooted in Cunningham, release, and floorwork, it weaves dynamic crossings, phrases, and guided improvisations shaped by Iole’s distinctive touch. You’ll play with momentum, texture, and flow, expanding coordination and expression. Open to movers with some experience, each session nurtures rhythm, body awareness, and freedom through a living dialogue of technique and artistry.

sessions.title: Beginner Contemporary
sessions.details: Wednesdays 7:30-8:30pm w/ Iole | This class invites you to explore movement and its connections, focusing on the principles and introduction to contemporary dance. Classes will cover the fundamental concepts of the main modern and contemporary dance techniques, including release, floor work, Cunningham, and more.

sessions.title: General Level Ballet

Isla Roebig creates a supportive and encouraging environment, balancing strong technical foundations with musicality and flow.

sessions.title: Open Level Contemporary

Chloe’s teaching emphasises musicality, individuality, and presence — creating a space where beginners feel supported and experienced movers can deepen their practice. Expect a thoughtful balance of structure and freedom, culminating in expansive, expressive choreography that celebrates movement in the moment.

sessions.title: Beginner Pointe (+Ballet Improver class prior)

This class introduces the fundamental principles of dancing en pointe at a gradual and thoughtful pace. Dancers will focus on correct alignment, strength, balance, and articulation of the feet, while deepening their understanding of placement and coordination developed in the improvers class. ​ Following the same open and reflective atmosphere, dancers are encouraged to listen closely to their bodies and progress with care and patience. sessions.title: Women-only Vocal / Nasheeds (Beginner)
sessions.details: Laban Building • Creekside, London, SE8 3DZ, UK, London • This women-only beginner class is built around movement, rather than by a heavy beat or familiar lyrical structure. Instead of music, the class uses vocals and/or nasheeds, offering a different kind of soundscape for movement that feels stripped back, open and deeply personal. The class is ideal for women who want to step away from secular music or music altogether, and for those who are looking for a space that feels culturally sensitive, private and genuinely welcoming. It is also a beautiful option for women who want to experience dance in a different way, where the body, mind and breath have more space to lead. Movement in this class can feel soft, expressive, grounding, or whatever it needs to be for you. Because there is less sound to lean on, the class creates an eye-opening experience: you are invited to trust your own instincts, your own rhythm and your own interpretation. That can feel honest, freeing and surprisingly liberating. The atmosphere values community, uplift and comfort, so you can come solo or with a friend and feel held in the room. Who it’s for Women looking for a safe, private and culturally sensitive space to dance for the first time or return to movement after a break. Those who value community as much as the dance itself, whether they come solo or with a friend. Women who prefer to move without secular music or without music altogether. Women who want a different sound and a different relationship to movement. What to expect You will begin with a short introduction before moving into a beginner-friendly session that includes guided movement, simple choreography and space for self-expression. The class is designed to help you feel comfortable, supported and free to move at your own pace. Outcome You leave feeling grounded, liberated and more connected to your own movement, with a stronger sense of confidence and self-expression. Practical note Please arrive 10–15 minutes early so you can settle in and get familiar with the space before class begins. Suitable for most fitness levels. If you are pregnant, postnatal or managing an injury, please let the team know in advance so adjustments can be made. What to Wear Anything you feel comfortable in and able to move freely. This class is 18+ only. By purchasing a ticket, you agree to these terms and conditions.

sessions.title: Women-only Stretch Class
sessions.details: Laban Building • Creekside, London, SE8 3DZ, UK, London • This women-only stretch class is a highly requested add-on for anyone who wants a low-pressure space dedicated entirely to stretching. It is not yoga. Instead, it is a guided group fitness session built to improve flexibility, mobility and range of motion through focused, full-body stretching techniques. The class combines static stretching, dynamic movement and PNF-style contract-relax work, making it both restorative and functional. It is designed for people who want to carve out time to stretch properly, without rushing and without needing to fit it into a bigger dance or fitness class. The women-only environment adds an extra layer of comfort and relatability, making it easier to switch off, settle in and focus on your own body. By the end of the session, you should feel physically lighter, taller, more open and less stiff, with a calmer mind and a stronger sense of connection to your body. Because stretching time is often overlooked in busy schedules, this class creates a rare space where you can slow down, move with care, and leave feeling both released and re-energised. Who it’s for Women who want a calm, private, and comfortable space to stretch. Women who want to improve flexibility, mobility and range of motion. Women who prefer a guided stretch session rather than yoga. Women who want time to release tension and reset. What to expect You will move through a guided stretch and mobility session that combines careful, full-body work with space to breathe, release and settle into the room. The pace is controlled, supportive and focused on making the body feel more open and available. Every ticket includes a goody bag. Outcome You leave feeling looser, freer, more open through the body and more mentally settled. Practical note Please arrive 10–15 minutes early so you can settle in and get familiar with the space before class begins. If you are pregnant, postnatal, or managing an injury, please let the team know in advance so adjustments can be made. What to Wear Anything you feel comfortable in and able to stretch freely. This class is 18+ only. By purchasing a ticket, you agree to these terms and conditions.

sessions.title: The Movements
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • Meditation through movementThe Movements are a collection of sacred dances, exercises, prayers and their accompanying music that originated from various schools, dervish orders and monasteries across the Middle East and Central Asia. They were collected and brought to the West by the philosopher and mystic, G.I. Gurdjieff. They were first taught in England to Ouspensky’s pupils at Lyne Place and Colet House in the 1930s. The Study Society is unique in teaching the early repertoire of Movements as they were originally taught, in an unchanged line to the present day.The Movements provide a non-verbal way of experiencing the essence of the Fourth Way teaching. They convey knowledge about the great universal laws and can be a vehicle for expressing universal truths. They can be thought of as a special form of ‘moving meditation’. Through the practice of attention they can enable participants to experience the working of finer energies, bringing all parts of the human organism into a more harmonious whole.The Study Society offers these evenings free of charge, but you are invited to make a donation to support the charity in its works.Meditation through movementThe Movements are a collection of sacred dances, exercises, prayers and their accompanying music that originated from various schools, dervish orders and monasteries across the Middle East and Central Asia. sessions.title: 5Rhythms with Flow
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • In 5Rhythms, we hand over prayer to the body, allowing it to become our wisest teacher. Through movement, we invite the body to express its unique rhythm in the present moment, uncovering its often suppressed intelligence.Flow Vulk brings her own energy and vision to the dance. In her words:"I found my feet on a 5Rhythms dance floor in 2014. This is when and where it all magnificently fell apart before falling into place and making sense. It is in our bones, blood and breath - the beat, the rhythm, the Song of Songs. The Song of Life. Dance it. This is how we wake up, how we become alive again, how we find answers and resolutions. We dance not to forget but to remember, not to get lost but to find ourselves, not to disappear but to arise in our full, authentic glory. So let this be an open invitation to shake off the cobwebs, rattle those bones, let that breath flow and let your feet find their beat. Let Life In."All are welcome, whether you’re new to 5Rhythms or have danced it for years.In 5Rhythms, we hand over prayer to the body, allowing it to become our wisest teacher. sessions.title: Jin Mai Gong Qigong (Yang Exercises)
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • JIN MAI GONG QIGONG (YANG EXERCISES)A Seven-Week Qigong Course with Natalia Miralles Huete📅 Course dates: 7 sessions from 5th November to 17th December🕑 Day and time: Thursdays, 18:30–19:30📍 Location: Top Studio, Colet HouseDrop-ins also available. Beginners welcome!Join Natalia at Colet House from 5th November to learn a Qigong system called Jin Mai Gong that will help restore the free flow of energy (Qi) throughout your body.In this course, you will learn six Qigong exercises that help keep the energy of the six YANG organs of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) flowing smoothly through their meridians, preventing blockages and, consequently, the development of illness.These exercises complement the six movements we learnt in the previous course, where we focused on the six YIN organs. However, you don’t need to have completed the previous course to attend this one, as the exercises are completely different.Qigong is an ancient Chinese art for energy cultivation. This vital energy, known as Qi (or Chi), flows continuously throughout the body via a network of channels that act like a vast system of rivers and tributaries, nourishing our whole organism.Some of these channels are called meridians and are responsible for supplying our internal organs with Qi in a smooth and continuous way. When this flow of Qi becomes excessive, deficient or blocked, the body's balance is disrupted and illness may arise.In this seven-week course, we will work specifically on the six tendino-muscular (sinew) meridians associated with the six Yang organs:Large IntestineStomachSmall IntestineUrinary BladderSan Jiao (Triple Burner)Gall BladderThese tendino-muscular meridians are made up of the tendons, muscles and fascia that surround the main meridians. Using effective stretches, breathing techniques and circular and spiralling movements, we will work to release restrictions in these tissues, allowing Qi to flow more freely through the meridians.Benefits of this Qigong system:Releases blockages and restores the free flow of Qi through the meridians, improving the function of the internal organs.Improves the emotional states associated with energetic imbalances in the internal organs.Helps eliminate excess fat and toxins accumulated in the fascia.Strengthens the immune system by supporting the body's defensive energy (Wei Qi) in the subcutaneous layers.Supports recovery from muscular tension, ligament problems, inflammation and joint weakness.Promotes greater freedom of movement throughout the body.JIN MAI GONG QIGONG (YANG EXERCISES)A Seven-Week Qigong Course with Natalia Miralles Huete📅 Course dates: 7 sessions from 5th November to 17th December🕑 Day and time: Thursdays, 18:30–19:30📍 Location: Top Studio, Colet HouseDrop-ins also available. sessions.title: Drum Circle (6-session series)
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • Get ready to drum up some rhythm at our Drum Circle event! Immerse yourself in a beat-packed 6-session series – whether you're in for the whole groove with full-course tickets or feel like jamming spontaneously with our drop-in tickets. Let's keep the vibe rhythmic!Alternate Thursdays 19:30 - 21:00, West Studio (Sept 24th - Dec 3rd)Our African Drum Circle workshop in London gives you the chance to learn to play the African “Djembe” Drum. Explore the “bass, tone, slap” sounds of this instrument and discover why African drumming is irresistible.Drumming is a great way to release stress and develop creativity, and it’s also the oldest form of communal musical bonding. The class will also include time to dance, shake and move to the beat.Drums are provided. No experience needed!With Ailon & KayKay SmithI have been playing djembe for 15 years and love to perform and teach. I like to describe my drum circle sessions as an introduction to the Joys of Djembe. I love what I do and it makes me happy to be able to share my passion with others. sessions.title: The Yoga of Vocal Sound, Movement and Meditation
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • Are you ready to embark on a journey of self-transformation? Join James D’Angelo – a leading authority on sound healing – in uncovering one of the great aspects of attaining true sound health through the tuning of the chakras.In this unique workshop, James will introduce you to vocal homeopathy, and its processes by which the chakras are stimulated and re-tuned, clearing blockages and releasing fine energies. Alongside the therapeutic use of voice, he will bring in embodiment practices with Chi Kung-like movements integrating them into the toning practices. Finally, and complementary to the chakra work, you will experience samples of Taoist healing sounds/movements. sessions.title: Culture Remix: Voice & Song Circle
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • CULTURE REMIX: VOICE & SONG CIRCLEA fortnightly collective of voice and unityA space to come back to yourself and rise together through resonance in choral harmony. Through song and voice, this circle offers a simple way to release, connect, and land - no performance, no right way to do it, just presence and shared vibes.Alongside singing, breathwork and light exercises support expression and presence - helping everyone in the room find their own voice, harmonies, frequencies and depth of connection to self and the group. There will be a cultural mix of repertoires and styles to explore.The circle includes:✦ Song and voice - open to all, no experience needed✦ Presence and expression - light exercises to help you arrive and open up✦ Conversation and wordplay - space to be heard and to listen✦ Science and Soul - looking at frequencies, breath and depth of sound✦ Rhythm and Roots - using key principles of heartbeat and groundingWhy it matters: In a fast-moving, over-productive world, this is a space to put all of that down - to reconnect with your own voice and a sense of freedom, all in a way that asks nothing of you but your presence.Come as you are.Format: Fortnightly | Thursday eveningsVenue: Colet HouseJimi LyonsA graduate of the British Academy of New Music and recipient of its National Music Facilitator of the Year award, Jimi Lyons has spent over five decades as a respected musician and mentor at the heart of the UK music industry, co-founding the iconic Vibes & Pressure at Passing Clouds, Dalston with Natty. He's led drum and song circles worldwide in both Nyabinghi and other cultural, spiritual and musical traditions and worked alongside industry cornerstones such as Sade, Julian Marley, Danny Sims, Dennis Brown and Bunny Wailer, to name a few. Jimi brings that depth of experience into the circle with warmth and ease — holding space for voice and play, and opening the room to connection and presence.Melissa RoseA graduate of Guildford School of Acting with a First Class Master's in Musical Theatre, and a BSc in Microbiology from the University of Nottingham, Melissa Rose has spent over seventeen years as a voice, confidence and performance specialist, and founder of InnerVox. sessions.title: Drum Circle (6-session series)
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • Get ready to drum up some rhythm at our Drum Circle event! Immerse yourself in a beat-packed 6-session series – whether you're in for the whole groove with full-course tickets or feel like jamming spontaneously with our drop-in tickets. Let's keep the vibe rhythmic!Alternate Thursdays 19:30 - 21:00, West Studio (Apr 30th - Jul 9th)Our African Drum Circle workshop in London gives you the chance to learn to play the African “Djembe” Drum. Explore the “bass, tone, slap” sounds of this instrument and discover why African drumming is irresistible.Drumming is a great way to release stress and develop creativity, and it’s also the oldest form of communal musical bonding. The class will also include time to dance, shake and move to the beat.Drums are provided. No experience needed!With Ailon & KayKay SmithI have been playing djembe for 15 years and love to perform and teach. sessions.title: Somatic Dance: The Body as Home
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • A Calling Home – The Body as Home is a Somatic Activated Healing™ (SAH Method) practice, a trauma-informed, body-based approach that blends: somatic movement breath work mantra and meditation music and free, intuitive movement.Rather than intellectualizing or talking about emotions, this practice invites the body to lead, allowing sensations and stored emotions to be expressed and gently released through movement. We work from a bottom-up approach, using the body and felt sensations as the entry point, rather than analyzing thoughts or revisiting specific traumatic memories. As a certified SAH Method™ teacher, I guide participants to “drop the story and be with the feeling,” creating a safe space for emotions to move without re-engaging with the narratives around them. Participants can expect a guided, supportive experience that helps to: ground and regulate the nervous system reconnect with physical sensations gently release what has been held in the body cultivate moments of safety, steadiness, and embodied presence There is no choreography, no performance, and no “right way” to move. This session is an invitation to move, shake, soften, and play, to let energy flow more freely through the body, release what feels stuck, and reconnect with joy, aliveness, and a sense of home within.Still wondering what to expect? sessions.title: Playfulness for Beginners (4-week course)
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • 7.15-9.00pm on Wednesdays June 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24thWho says your spiritual practice needs to be serious? What if playfulness could become a pathway towards self-discovery and wholeness?Come and join us for this 4-week introductory ‘practice of playfulness' journey, where grown up adults can reconnect with their often buried sense of childlike play. We will draw from the worlds of clowning, improv, mime and dance as well as spontaneous silliness and generalised irreverence. Together, this unlikely cocktail will leave you feeling joyous, open-hearted and flooded with endorphins.Through a range of games and structures, we will explore aspects of play such as spontaneity, misbehaviour, exuberance, sensitivity, connection and totality - and also take time to explore and process how we are feeling as we undergo the journey.The workshops will be a safe space with no pressure ‘to perform’- although the urge may arise. Rather the aim is to build an encouraging supportive nest from which you can launch yourself into your innately exuberant and playful aspect and free your inner child.Some aspects of the workshop will be held and structured, others will be a little bit free and spontaneous (and even occasionally anarchic), all interspersed with dancing and 'digestion time.' There will also be a chill-out area should you need to sit things out for a while ************* During this course you will: Discover how The Practice of Playfulness is a healing medicine that can transform emotions such as repression, numbness and disconnection into feelings of happiness, optimism and inner aliveness.See how the path of self-expression develops inner qualities such as courage, creativity, confidence and improved communication skills.Understand how play gives a strong taste of emotional freedom and moment-by-moment living in a real, embodied way.Be supported through regular sharing circles and times for self-reflection. ************* Read other people's experience of the course:“I believe that what Ailon is offering is incredibly powerful and if you want to live life with a bit more lightheartedness then you should definitely go along to his workshops!”“Thank you for an enriching and ridiculous 6 weeks of playfulness.I loved the journey and cultivating the trust to play together allowed fresh and unexpected expressions to emerge.”“For me this is less of a class or workshop and more of a happening…a congregation of joyful souls happy to hang out and relax in a climate of friendliness. Out of that trust, true silliness and fun can emerge.”“Thank you for bringing into fruition a space which is so playful and nourishing to the soul. To have all our parts to come up and be met, not only with with encouragement but with love is so rare in this world- it takes weird and deep to awaken and meet weird and deep!”“ It’s been a pleasure being on this journey with every single one of you and see everyone expand and grow on this journey into deeper expression of our selves. I appreciate everyone’s acceptance and kindness. It’s been the first place in a long time where I felt safe and accepted to just be myself and explore parts of myself no matter how crazy, silly and unexpected.”"Ailon creates such a safe and humorous space for people to explore their inner joker and let go of their inhibitions. I’ve given myself permission to be playful again and it’s been so liberating to reconnect with that part of me."“What a pleasure and a privilege to be part of this workshop” “Like being drunk with no alcohol”****************They can't all be wrong ???Any questions email: ailon@schoolofplayfulness.co.ukTo read more about Ailon (the founder)'s journey into playfulness have a look herehttps://ailonfreedman.substack.com/p/birthing-the-school-of-playfulness7.15-9.00pm on Wednesdays June 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24thWho says your spiritual practice needs to be serious? sessions.title: Baduanjin Qigong (8-week course)
sessions.details: Colet House, 151 Talgarth Rd, London W14 9DA • BADUANJIN QIGONG – The Eight Silk BrocadesAn Eight-Week Qigong Course with Natalia Miralles Huete📅 Course dates: 8 classes from 9 April to 11 June (No class on 23 April and 4 June)18:30 – 19:30📍 Location: Top Studio, Colet HouseBaduanjin, also known as “The Eight Silk Brocades”, is an ancient Qigong set of eight different fluid movements that together condition the whole body externally — stretching and strengthening it — and internally, improving the function of the organs and systems (respiratory, circulatory, digestive, nervous, etc.).The set was first described in an eighth-century Taoist text, and it is known to have been used effectively throughout the 17th century during wars in China to alleviate soldiers’ fatigue. This is a key aspect of Qigong, as it helps us to regain energy and vitality to go about our modern daily lives and face our inner battles of stress and emotional challenges.Baduanjin represents an excellent short daily health routine. It will provide you with a whole-body workout, mobilising all your joints, strengthening your muscles and bones, and improving your posture and balance, while helping to focus and calm your busy mind. Your emotions will also feel more balanced, and your energy levels will increase.Once you have learnt the set, it will take you just 20 minutes to complete, although the practice can be shorter or longer depending on the number of repetitions. If you persevere in practising the set daily or a few times per week after the course, you will soon notice the health benefits it brings.The course also includes the essential foundations for effective Qigong practice: breathing techniques, preparatory self-massage, structured joint-opening exercises, and the “three regulations” — body, breath and mind — providing a clear and methodical framework for practising Baduanjin safely and efficiently.BADUANJIN QIGONG – The Eight Silk BrocadesAn Eight-Week Qigong Course with Natalia Miralles Huete📅 Course dates: 8 classes from 9 April to 11 June (No class on 23 April and 4 June)18:30 – 19:30📍 Location: Top Studio, Colet HouseBaduanjin, also known as “The Eight Silk Brocades”, is an ancient Qigong set of eight different fluid movements that together condition the whole body externally — stretching and strengthening it — and internally, improving the function of the organs and systems (respiratory, circulatory, digestive, nervous, etc.).The set was first described in an eighth-century Taoist text, and it is known to have been used effectively throughout the 17th century during wars in China to alleviate soldiers’ fatigue. sessions.title: Queer Salsa | Intermediate Salsa Shines Class
sessions.details: ✨SPECIAL Intermediate Salsa Shines Class✨Style: Crossbody-on-1 🎟️ Spots are limited, when we sell out we will put the waitlist on We have limited low-income spots for £5 and free spots. Get in contact if you need one. 💃 Class SummaryLearn to express yourself to the complex rhythms of salsa through solo footwork. This class is for dancers who can do a range of salsa footwork confidently and are eager to challenge themselves and learn even more. At the minimum, you should come into the class being able to do a confident basic step, sidestep, right and left turns, and Suzie Q. 💃 Crossbody salsa Salsa dancing began in the streets, shaped by many communities across Latin America and the diaspora. Over time, shared styles developed so people could dance together, each one shaped by its own history, music, and context.Crossbody Salsa, also known as En Línea, developed in LA and New York, where Latin American and Caribbean diasporic communities were influenced by local dance styles like Swing, Hustle, and Ballroom. It’s danced in a line, with partners facing each other and switching places back and forth. In contrast, Cuban and Cali styles are danced in more circular movements. 💃 Welfare & AccessibilityStep free access & accessible gender-neutral toilets We’re always working to make our events safer and more inclusive. sessions.title: Queer Salsa | Absolute Beginners Class & Free Social
sessions.details: Absolute Beginners Cuban Salsa ClassLearn the basics of salsa ryhthm, footwork and partnerwork in our Absolute Beginners Cuban Salsa & Rueda ClassIt’s ideal if you’re completely new to Cuban Salsa, returning after a break, coming from another Salsa or Afro-Latin style, or exploring a new dance role.After the class there will be a FREE SOCIAL where you can meet and dance with more of the Queer Salsa community.Timings7:00 - 9:00 Absolute Beginners Cuban Salsa & Rueda Class9:00 - 11:00 Free Social 💛 About Cuban Salsa & Rueda de CasinoSalsa was born in Cuba, created by enslaved African people and their descendants. Rooted in African rhythms, movement, and ways of dancing together, Salsa is a dance of joy, survival, resistance, and collective celebration. It carries histories of struggle alongside playfulness, creativity, and deep community connection.Cuban Salsa, also known as Casino, developed in Havana’s social dance halls. It’s a circular, grounded style that emphasises rotation, rhythm, improvisation, and shared connection. Unlike Cross-Body Salsa, which travels along a line, Casino moves around a common center.Rueda de Casino grew out of social Casino dancing in Havana, when groups of friends began dancing together in a circle and playfully changing partners. Using simple called moves, Rueda turns salsa into a shared group experience.
